verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists a 'Web Google Chrome' platform, which suggests a browser client. Its share-a-link collaboration lets a team member observe or take control. However, the evidence never says the web client needs nothing installed, works outside Chrome, or that shared links open directly in a browser. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of zero-install browser access, support beyond Google Chrome, documentation that shared links open view/control sessions in-browser, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
